title: Controlled Demonstration of a Tank Trailer Vacuum Collapse by Wabash National
summary: A controlled demonstration by Wabash National of a tank trailer collapsing under vacuum, staged at an industry expo. The tank implodes as air is pulled out.
why: HN uses it as a vivid illustration of vacuum and pressure vessel failure in threads on hyperloop and submersible implosions.

quote.text: This is what a controlled vacuum implosion of a liquid tank looks like at 1 atmosphere of pressure
